16000.meaning1: higher state of being; superior state of existence

examples.text: upasampanno nāma uparibhāvaṃ samāpanno, patto'ti attho. bhikkhubhāvo hi uparibhāvo, tañ'c'esa yathāvuttena kammena samāpannattā, upasampanno'ti vuccati.

16001.meaning1: leading to higher states of existence

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, cunda, ye keci akusalā dhammā sabbe te adhobhāgaṅ'gamanīyā, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te uparibhāvaṅ'gamanīyā, evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti uparibhāgāya
aññataro bhikkhu heṭṭhā hutvā silaṃ uccāresi. uparimena bhikkhunā duggahitā silā heṭṭhimassa bhikkhuno matthake avatthāsi. so bhikkhu kālam'akāsi

16003.meaning2: destined for the higher three paths and enlightenment

16007.commentary: (UDa) uparimuddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ vihaccā'ti bhagavato muddhappadesassa upari attano mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ pasāretvā. phaṇaṃ karitvā'ti'pi pāṭho, so ev'attho.

examples.text: atha kho mucalindo nāgarājā sakabhavanā nikkhamitvā bhagavato kāyaṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā uparimuddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ karitvā aṭṭhāsi

16009.meaning1: later in the discourse with Subha

16010.construction:
upari + sela + sutta + e
upariselasutta + e

examples.text: [opātentu (sī.) upariselasutte pana opātethāti'y'eva dissati]

16011.commentary: (VINa) uparivehāsakuṭiyā'ti upari acchannatalāya dvibhūmikakuṭiyā vā tibhūmikādikuṭiyā vā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.

16012.meaning1: loft bedroom; upper-floor room; attic room
16012.commentary: (VINa) uparivehāsakuṭiyā'ti upari acchannatalāya dvibhūmikakuṭiyā vā tibhūmikādikuṭiyā vā, vehāsakuṭī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.

16013.meaning2: hut with its top story open to the air (?)

16014.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of uparivehāsa
16014.meaning1: up in the air; in the sky above

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho āyasaṃ vajiraṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti, sac'āyaṃ saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā yāvatatiyaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākarissati etth'ev'assa sattadhā muddhaṃ phālessāmī'ti.

16015.meaning1: is stopped; is ended; is finished

examples.text: sabbaloke ca atam'mayo bhavissāmi, ahaṅ'kārā ca me uparujjhissanti, mamaṅ'kārā ca me uparujjhissanti
yam'etaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, ajita taṃ vadāmi te, yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, viññāṇassa nirodhena, etth'etaṃ uparujjhati.

16017.meaning1: stopped; blocked; prevented; held in check

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.

16020.meaning2: keeps in check, stops or hinder
16020.commentary: (THa) uparundhantī'ti vibādhenti. (THa) manovicāre uparundha cetaso'ti manovicārasaññino gehasita-somanass'upavicār'ādike aṭṭhārasa cetaso uparundha vārehi nirodhehi.

examples.text: aniccaṃ dukkhan'ti vipassa yoniso, suññaṃ anattā'ti aghaṃ vadhan'ti ca, manovicāre uparundha cetaso, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
mūlaṃ papañcasaṅkhāya, mantā asmī'ti sabbam'uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe.

16021.meaning1: stopped; blocked; prevented; held in check
16021.meaning2: kept in check, stopped or hinder

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ appāṇakaṃ'y'eva jhānaṃ jhāyeyyan'ti. so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.

16023.commentary: (SNPa) saṅkhāre uparundhiyā'ti kammaṃ kammasampayutte ca saṅkhāre nirodhetvā.

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ iñjitapaccayā, tasmā hi ejaṃ vossajja, saṅkhāre uparundhiya, anejo anupādāno, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.

16024.meaning1: who gets reborn in a higher realm; who reappears higher

examples.text: āgantā itthattan'ti itthattaṃ mānusaka-pañcakkhandhabhāvam'eva āgantā hoti. tatr'ūpapattiko vā upar'ūpapattiko vā na hoti, puna heṭṭhāgāmī'y'eva hotī'ti dasseti.

16025.meaning1: to the peak; right on top (of); over
16025.meaning2: higher and higher; over; on top of; right above

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pubb'eva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto'va samāno mahato mīḷhapabbatassa upar'ūpari caṅkamati alippamāno mīḷhena.
sukhan'ti diṭṭham'ariyehi, sakkāyass'uparodhanaṃ, paccanīkam'idaṃ hoti, sabbalokena passataṃ.
etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, sabbasaṅkhārasamathā, saññānaṃ uparodhanā, evaṃ dukkhakkhayo hoti, etaṃ ñatvā yathātathaṃ.

16029.meaning1: makes stop; interrupts; causes to end
16029.commentary: (VINa) yasmā pana jīvitā voropanaṃ nāma atthato jīvit'indriy'upacchedanam'eva hoti, tasmā etassa padabhājane jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopetī'ti vuttaṃ. tattha jīvit'indriyassa paveṇighaṭanaṃ upacchindanto uparodhento ca jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodhetī'ti vuccati. sv'āyam'attho santatiṃ vikopetī'ti-padena dassito.

examples.text: yaṃ kuddho uparodheti, sukaraṃ viya dukkaraṃ, pacchā so vigate kodhe, aggidaḍḍho'va tappati.
jīvitā voropeyyā'ti jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopeti.

16040.meaning1: is found; exists; is present; is obtainable (in)

examples.text: kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

16044.meaning2: is found, exists; is perceived; is ascertained

16047.meaning2: is found, exists; is perceived; is ascertained; (upalabbhati)

16052.meaning2: for the sake of buttering up

16054.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.10) upalāpeyya vā'ti tassa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā uddesaṃ vā paripucchaṃ vā dassāmī'ti upalāpeti (VINa) upalāpeyyā'ti saṅgaṇheyya.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

16056.meaning1: to persuade, to coax; to entice (somebody with)
16056.commentary: (SNa) upalāpetun'ti aññam'aññaṃ bhindituṃ. yathā dve janā ekena maggena na gacchanti evaṃ kātuṃ. (SNt) upalāpetun'ti paresaṃ antare virodh'atthaṃ saṅgaṇhituṃ.

examples.text: saṃvijjati kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañ'c'eva vehāsaṭṭhañ'ca, yena mayaṃ pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ. tesam'pi, bhante, dhanayuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
so yena aññataro gāmo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā majjhe gāmassa ṭhito tikkhattuṃ saṅkhaṃ upalāpetvā saṅkhaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
so tasmiṃ saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati. tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare upalikkhanti, tam'enaṃ apanenti, apanetvā ñātakānaṃ nenti. so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti.
so tasmiṃ saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati. tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare upalikhanti, tam'enaṃ apanenti, apanetvā ñātakānaṃ nenti. so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti.

16070.synonym: atthata, ācita, channaka, vitata, santhata, santharita

examples.text: so tattha anantarahitāya bhūmiyā harit'upalittāya seyyaṃ kappeti.

16071.meaning1: is dirtied; is soiled; is defiled (by)

examples.text: so evam'āha, seyyathā'pi, bho, aggi sucim'pi ḍahati asucim'pi ḍahati, na ca tena aggi upalippati, evam'evaṃ kho, bho, sabbakammehi ce'pi brāhmaṇo jīvikaṃ kappeti, na ca tena brāhmaṇo upalippati.

16072.meaning2: is attached to, sticks, adheres (to, locative)

16073.meaning1: smears; coats; stains; sticks to; contaminates

examples.text: sukhumacchavi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo. sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalimpati, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati. upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.

16074.meaning1: is smeared; is coated; is stained; is contaminated (by)
16074.notes: active base but passive meaning. perhaps a textual error.

examples.text: udabindu yathā'pi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati, evaṃ muni na-upalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.
yathā'pi udake jātā, kumudā mandālakā bahū, upalimpanti toyena, kaddamakalalena ca.

16078.commentary: (ITIa) saro diddho kalāpaṃ vā'ti yathā nāma saro visena diddho litto sarakalāpagato sarasamūhasaṅkhātaṃ sarakalāpaṃ attanā phuṭṭhaṃ alittam'pi upalimpati, evaṃ pāpena upalepabhayā dhīro'ti dhitisampannattā dhīro paṇḍitapuriso pāpasahāyo na bhaveyya.

examples.text: sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati. upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷha-upalepanena.

16084.meaning1: (gram) preposition; prefix; prepositional part of speech

examples.text: yaṃ pan'etaṃ, evaṃ me sutan'tiādikaṃ nidānaṃ, tattha evan'ti nipātapadaṃ. me'tiādīni nāmapadāni. sāvatthiyaṃ viharatī'ti ettha vī'ti upasaggapadaṃ, haratī'ti ākhyātapadan'ti iminā tāva nayena padavibhāgo veditabbo.
imāni, bhante, asīti gāmikasahassāni idha-upasaṅkantāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. sādhu mayaṃ, bhante, labheyyāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā'ti.

16086.meaning1: may the venerable approach!; reverend go to!

examples.text: upasaṅkamat'āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī'ti.
sace bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissati, bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, savanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, upasaṅkamanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
disvāna yen'āyasmā revato ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca, upasaṅkamantā kho amū, āvuso revata, sappurisā yen'āyasmā sāriputto tena dhammassavanāya.
ayañ'hi so udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañ'ca bhusañ'ca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandanto maññe ṭhito'ti!
atha kho āyasmā ānando pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya yena aññataro bhikkhun'upassayo ten'upasaṅkami
kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

16091.meaning1: should be approached; could be visited (by)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ. n'āmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.
tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamī'ti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno evam'āha, ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti?
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato bhavanti upasaṅkamitāro

16093.meaning1: who approaches; who comes to see

examples.text: saddho ca, puṇṇiya, bhikkhu hoti, no ca upasaṅkamitā, n'eva tāva tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti. yato ca kho, puṇṇiya, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti upasaṅkamitā ca, evaṃ tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti.
abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā. tatra'pi mayā sannisinnapubbañ'c'eva, sallapitapubbañ'ca, sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā.

16094.meaning1: wanting to visit; wishing to meet

examples.text: cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, api ca devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ kehici kehici kiccakaraṇīyehi byāvaṭo, ev'āhaṃ n'āsakkhiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.

16095.meaning1: to approach; to visit; to go (to)

examples.text: na arahati bhavaṃ kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. samaṇo tv'eva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
na kho, bhikkhu, sukaro so bhagavā amhehi upasaṅkamituṃ, aññāhi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi parivuto.

16096.meaning1: having approached; having gone; having drawn near (to)

examples.text: ty'āhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi, saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti?
upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.
disvā pāsādachāyāyaṃ, caṅkamantaṃ nar'uttamaṃ, tattha naṃ upasaṅkamma, vandisaṃ puris'uttamaṃ.
eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti

16099.commentary: (DNa) pād'ūpasaṅgayhā'ti pāde upasaṅgayha pādadhovana-pādamakkhan'ānuppadānena pūjetvā c'eva vanditvā ca.

examples.text: annena pānena upaṭṭhahimhā, pāde-upasaṅgayha sake nivesane, kutomukhā nāma ime bhavanto, buddhassa dhammāni paṭiggahesuṃ.
